an10.175:1.1: Saparikkamano ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo aparikkamano.
an10.175:1.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave saparikkamano ayaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo aparikkamano? 2.
an10.175:1.3: Pāṇātipātissa bhikkhave pāṇātipātā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.4: adinnādāyissa bhikkhave adinnādānā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.5: kāmesu micchācārassa bhikkhave kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.6: musāvādassa bhikkhave musāvādā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.7: pisunāvācassa bhikkhave pisunāya vācāya veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.8: pharusāvācassa bhikkhave pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.9: samphappalāpassa bhikkhave samphappalāpā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti,
an10.175:1.13: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave parikkamanaṃ hoti. Evaṃ kho bhikkhave saparikkamano ayaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo aparikkamano
